name: fSuSiE
model_likelihood: Multiple wavelet regression D = X F + E with independent homoscedastic Gaussian residuals
prior: Sum of R single-function effects with adaptive normal-mixture wavelet priors
inference_algorithm: IBSS updates of single functions with a factorized variational posterior
data_input: Matched individual-level molecular-trait and genotype matrices
tunable_settings: Rmax; IS or SPS prior; mixture grid K and variances; pointwise interval level; optional purity filtering

name: Single function regression (SFR)
model_likelihood: Multiple wavelet regression constrained to one selected covariate
prior: One-hot multinomial selector with independent effect priors over wavelet locations
inference_algorithm: Analytical posterior from marginal regressions for fixed hyperparameters
estimand: SNP inclusion probabilities and conditional posterior effect mixtures
data_input: Genotype matrix X and wavelet-transformed response D
tunable_settings: Prior SNP probabilities; mixture component grid and prior weights

name: Simple Bayesian functional regression
estimand: Posterior mean and variance for each wavelet effect
data_input: N-by-T wavelet response D and one length-N covariate x
tunable_settings: Prior effect variance; residual variance held fixed in the elementary derivation
